unit:
# /home/entityfx/.config/systemd/user/mqtty-web.service
[Unit]
Description=MqttY.Web local simulation host with evidence-disk monitoring
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/mountpoint -q "/run/media/entityfx/hd250"
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 "/run/media/entityfx/hd250/mqtty-evidence/web-linux-v1/host/releases/10587525c3a4f204948401b926ab1ec8d6f9fca944bf999c9ef9263d567963aa/linux_web_host.py" serve --release "/run/media/entityfx/hd250/mqtty-evidence/web-linux-v1/host/releases/10587525c3a4f204948401b926ab1ec8d6f9fca944bf999c9ef9263d567963aa" --mount "/run/media/entityfx/hd250" --root "/run/media/entityfx/hd250/mqtty-evidence/web-linux-v1/host"
Restart=no
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=20
MemoryMax=2G
MemorySwapMax=0
CPUQuota=150%
TasksMax=256
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
StandardOutput=null
StandardError=journal
LogRateLimitIntervalSec=30s
LogRateLimitBurst=20

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
